title: Remote Jobs Aggregator input
description: Pick the job boards to pull from and optionally narrow the results by keyword, category and age. Each job listed is one billable result; a source that cannot be reached is reported for free.

sources.title: Job boards
sources.description: Which public job feeds to collect from. All five are used when nothing is selected.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keep only jobs whose title, company or tags contain at least one of these words (case-insensitive), e.g. `python`, `react`, `product manager`. Leave empty for all jobs.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Keep only jobs whose category or tags loosely match one of these, e.g. `programming`, `design`, `marketing`, `customer support`, `devops`. Matching is fuzzy because every board uses its own category names. Leave empty for all categories.

maxJobsPerSource.title: Max jobs per source
maxJobsPerSource.description: Upper limit of jobs collected from each board before filtering. Boards expose between roughly 100 and 1,000 recent jobs.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Skip jobs published more than this many days ago. Use 0 for no age limit.

dedupe.title: Remove duplicates across boards
dedupe.description: The same opening is often posted on several boards. When on, only the first copy of each title + company pair is kept.

includeDescription.title: Include HTML description
includeDescription.description: Add the full job description as HTML (`descriptionHtml`, capped at 20,000 characters). A plain-text excerpt (`descriptionText`, first 2,000 characters) is always included.

includeRaw.title: Include raw source record
includeRaw.description: Attach the unmodified item from the source API or feed under `raw`. Useful when you need a source-specific field that is not part of the normalized output. Makes the dataset larger.
